summary: Build team-ready prompt libraries, templates, and governance for consistent AI outputs. Learn through practical labs and real workflows.
lede: Building reusable prompt libraries and templates for teams provides a practical way to standardize prompt design, document task-specific instructions, and improve repeatability across business workflows. The course shows how to turn scattered prompts into a structured system using prompt inventories, template design, variable handling, output constraints, and version control. You will create and refine team-ready prompt assets for content drafting, analysis support, reporting, and workflow automation, including instruction-based prompts, role-based prompts, locked templates, and output templates for bullet lists, tables, and JSON-style responses. Practical exercises guide you in building a prompt catalogue, template register, testing checklist, and governance pack that support review, consistency, traceability, and ongoing maintenance.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to standardize AI prompting across a team, reduce output variation, and create reusable prompt assets that support daily work.
prerequisites: Prerequisites required: working familiarity with ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Claude, or a similar generative AI tool; comfort writing clear instructions for workplace tasks; and basic knowledge of how your team creates documents, reports, or content. No coding is required for completion, although the course does introduce structured prompt formatting and simple template variables at an operational level. If you already manage workflows, review outputs, or maintain SOPs, you will be able to apply the exercises directly to your context.
